chapters.title: Descriptive Statistics: center and spread
chapters.summary:
Mean, median, mode and when each is the better measure of the center.
Skewness and outliers; standard deviation as the measure of spread.

chapters.title: Probability Topics
chapters.summary:
Terminology of probability: experiment, outcome, sample space, event, equally likely outcomes.
Independent versus mutually exclusive events, sampling with and without replacement.

chapters.title: The Normal Distribution
chapters.summary:
The standard normal distribution and z-scores.
The Empirical Rule (68-95-99.7) and using the normal distribution to find probabilities.

chapters.title: Linear Regression and Correlation
chapters.summary:
Linear equations, scatter plots and the least-squares line of best fit.
Residuals, the sum of squared errors (SSE), the correlation coefficient r and r squared.
